versions.changelog:
- Added initial set of documentation and template files for doc-to-video, including reference guides and code templates.
- Fixed FFmpeg concat path bug and added a note about directory-relative paths.
- Added reference: macOS-specific Remotion (Chrome) gotcha.
- Implemented fast-path when total audio is already within the target range (no atempo needed).
- Introduced templates for Remotion scenes, audio processing scripts, and merging utilities.
- Expanded documentation with workflow guides for batch rendering, audio synchronization, and real-world use patterns.

Version 1.0.0 of doc-to-video

- Initial release: Automatically converts Markdown technical documents into professional 1080p videos with natural voiceover.
- Leverages edge-tts for text-to-speech, Remotion for visual rendering, and FFmpeg for audio/video merging and duration alignment.
- Provides a complete workflow, including tutorials for synchronizing audio/video, recommended component designs, and sample project structure.
- Supports one-click installation with SkillHub and manual setup instructions.
- Documentation includes troubleshooting tips and parameter recommendations for best results.
